record.title: Specify the recovered checked calibration record and build a read-only inspector
record.intent: Turn verified file-format knowledge into a reusable boundary without inventing instrument calibration values.
requirements: Work on host-side source and existing local evidence only. No physical access, guest run, new device response or modification of stock artifacts. Retain the recorded AFE bench question.

Specify byte layout, endianness, checksum coverage, size and trailing-byte behavior, metadata uncertainty and known stock load/save side effects. Separate format validity from calibration correctness and from exact stock acceptance semantics.

Implement a bounded read-only Kotlin inspector with typed results and TOML output. Report hashes and lengths without emitting proprietary payloads or host paths. Validate before presenting parsed payload metadata and never rewrite input records.

Exercise synthetic public conformance vectors for valid, truncated, corrupt, wrong-length and trailing-data cases, and verify the two existing stock LSB/vertical files read-only. Preserve fixture provenance and original hashes.
Commit and push specification, inspector and verification results before review.
acceptance: A scoped reusable checked-record specification and read-only inspector have reproducible conformance evidence.
